operations.rationale: The graph marks two separate proceedings as final: (1) ns1:cd.court_of_cassation_inadmissible_2009_09_23 is labelled as the last domestic decision in its track (company’s appeal on points of law), but (2) ns1:cd.arbitration_refusal_to_start_2008_10_07 is also marked is_final=true even though it appears to be an interlocutory/initial step outcome (president of the arbitration tribunal refusing to start arbitration) and is not presented in the quotes as the last domestic decision before the Strasbourg application. The scope note requires at most one DomesticProceeding per case with is_final=true, and only the one that closes the domestic remedies track exhausted before Strasbourg.
